name: Nimbus Air 14 versus Nimbus Air 16 [SAMPLE DATA]
question: Compare memory, display resolution, battery runtime, and port configuration between Nimbus Air 14 and Nimbus Air 16.

sources.title: Nimbus Air Official Product Specification Matrix [SAMPLE DATA]
